name: github-curator
description: Curate a GitHub account's repos: review a repo or README draft and get a recommendation (keep, publish, archive, make private or delete) with a scorecard, triage every repo at once, see who starred a repo and which stargazers work in the same field, see what people changed in their forks, list your merged pull requests to other people's projects, and keep a weekly history of your repos' traffic. It only recommends; it never changes a repo or contacts anyone.
